# Liquid Build

> Liquid Build is an AI-powered general contractor and developer in South Florida. We develop single-family communities and build custom homes, commercial build-outs, schools and data centers across Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties. We use AI to answer faster, estimate faster and keep permits moving, and experienced builders run every job.

Contact: 305-833-5025 (call or text) · uwecerron@gmail.com · Service area: Miami-Dade County, FL, Broward County, FL, Palm Beach County, FL.
Replies to quote requests within one business day.

## Services
- [Home Development](https://liquid-build.com/home-development): Single-family communities from land and entitlements to sitework, model homes and production building.
- [Design-Build](https://liquid-build.com/design-build): One contract and one team from first sketch to final inspection, with the budget set during design.
- [Commercial Build-Outs](https://liquid-build.com/commercial): Restaurant, retail and office build-outs built to brand spec and opening date.
- [Schools & Campuses](https://liquid-build.com/schools): Charter, private and higher-education construction phased around the school calendar.
- [Data Centers & Industrial](https://liquid-build.com/data-centers): Power-first site selection, sitework, shell and electrical and mechanical coordination for data centers and industrial buildings.

# Service details and FAQs

## Home Development (https://liquid-build.com/home-development)
Single-family communities from land and entitlements to sitework, model homes and production building.

**Do you develop land you don't own yet?**
Yes. We run feasibility before you close: yield, sitework budget, utilities, flood zone and a realistic schedule, so you know what the land can become.

**How many homes have you developed?**
Our team has developed 300+ homes and condo units in South Florida, including Redland Ranches (57 homes), Toscana (24 homes) and Las Palmas (19 units).

**Who handles permits and plats?**
We coordinate plats, zoning and building permits with our sister company Liquid Permit.

## Design-Build (https://liquid-build.com/design-build)
One contract and one team from first sketch to final inspection, with the budget set during design.

**What is design-build?**
One contract covers design, engineering, permits and construction. The team drawing the project is the team building it, so price and schedule are set early.

**Is design-build cheaper?**
It usually reduces surprises: the budget is checked during design instead of after bids come back, and permits and site work can start while drawings finish.

**What do you design-build?**
Custom homes, additions, pools, restaurant and retail interiors, school renovations and industrial buildings.

## Commercial Build-Outs (https://liquid-build.com/commercial)
Restaurant, retail and office build-outs built to brand spec and opening date.

**Which brands have you built for?**
Our team has built out locations for Chili's (FIU Graham Center), Starbucks and quick-service restaurants in Miami, plus retail renovations such as Oasis in Key Biscayne.

**Can you work while a business stays open?**
Yes. We phase work around operating hours for renovations of open restaurants and stores.

**Do you handle landlord and brand approvals?**
Yes. We coordinate drawings, landlord work letters, brand standards and permits.

## Schools & Campuses (https://liquid-build.com/schools)
Charter, private and higher-education construction phased around the school calendar.

**Can you finish over the summer?**
Yes. We plan school work in windows (nights, weekends and summers) so rooms are inspected and ready before class.

**What school work have you done?**
Recent campus work includes a second-floor remodel at Carlos Albizu University in Miami and Chili's at FIU's Graham Center.

**Do you build charter schools?**
Yes: new buildings, conversions of existing buildings and additions for charter and private schools.

## Data Centers & Industrial (https://liquid-build.com/data-centers)
Power-first site selection, sitework, shell and electrical and mechanical coordination for data centers and industrial buildings.

**What limits a data center schedule?**
Usually power: utility capacity, interconnection timelines and long-lead electrical equipment. We screen sites by available megawatts and time to energize before design.

**What part of a data center do you build?**
Site and power diligence, sitework and pads, shell and core, and coordination of switchgear, generator yards and cooling plant with your engineers.

**Do you build smaller edge sites?**
Yes, including prefabricated modules and small edge facilities.

# General FAQ

**What does Liquid Build do?**
Liquid Build is an AI-powered general contractor and developer in South Florida. We develop single-family communities and build custom homes, commercial build-outs, schools and data centers across Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties. We use AI to answer faster, estimate faster and keep permits moving, and experienced builders run every job.

**Where do you work?**
Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties. That covers Miami, Fort Lauderdale, West Palm Beach and the towns in between, including Key Biscayne, Homestead and the Redland.

**How fast do you reply to a quote request?**
Within one business day. Call or text 305-833-5025 for anything urgent.

**Can my AI assistant get an estimate from you?**
Yes. Agents can connect to our MCP server at https://liquid-build.com/api/mcp for company info, ballpark estimates, project grounding and quote requests. See https://liquid-build.com/agents.
